class_identity: original real CL global classifier row remains canonical; N=3238 and learned parameters unchanged; ontology view is independent row-to-node relationship adapter
distance_strata: nearest source CL undirected shortest path: near<=2, intermediate3..4, distant>=5; fixed before results; unmapped not evaluable

generic_star.dbr: original root/self exclusion leaves no valid coarse ancestors; all coarse memberships masked zero in same N×773 interface; original DBR coefficient retained with coarse similarity 0
generic_star.graph: SYNTHETIC_ROOT -> one distinct leaf per canonical source class; inactive padding to N=3238
generic_star.hcl: original >=3 shared-ancestor sampler retained; no valid positives under star, therefore zero valid relational HCL triplets
generic_star.naming: synthetic nodes are not biological lineage; native lineage correctness NA/not applicable; control is flat hierarchy, not removal of all class identity

leakage: split authority can read labels to freeze class withholding; blind trainer opens only source_tensors and target(x,raw,sf); evaluator runs in separate process only after membership/partition/LCC/prediction manifest hashes; accesses logged

lineage.correctness: ancestor-or-equal compatibility, cluster macro and cell weighted; exact deepest-common-ancestor set accuracy; undirected shortest path; over/under specificity
lineage.gt_mapping: preexisting unique valid cell_ontology_id; else unique exact CL name/EXACT synonym; else existing Wagner alias; otherwise NOT_EVALUABLE
lineage.secondary: same frozen partition with real and shuffled LCC; star training + real LCC diagnostic only
lineage.utility: sum assigned * ancestry-compatible * min(1,depth(pred)/depth(truth)) / all eligible evaluable cells; root-only excluded; includes known false positives

oracle_diagnostics: CPU only, after sealing; four cells fullPredNovel/GTNovel × no-K Leiden/oracle true-K KMeans; frozen OverallJ only oracle diagnostic
preprocessing: preserve final transductive all-input expression preprocessing; source labels only train/calibrate; prepared once per dataset; exclusive cell split once per dataset×seed
real: unchanged compiled CL release 2025-12-17; root CL:0000000; all source HCL/DBR/coarse/LCC paths use real view
retry: No automatic scientific/config retries. For nonzero run exit preserve attempt and mark FAILED; continue other registered runs. Integrity/hash drift stops launches; interrupted run requires new attempt directory and amendment. No deletion or outcome-based stopping.

rng.calibration: original local torch Generator model_seed + frozen CALIBRATION_SEED_OFFSET
rng.dataloader: separate CPU Generator cloned from exact original post-model-init CPU state, shared across loaders to preserve original batch order
rng.numpy: model seed; mapping separate local PCG64
rng.torch_cuda: model seed; original CUDA dropout/HCL stream preserved

scope: TONIGHT ONLY P0 core + CPU frozen-output diagnostics; P1/P2/P3/additional permutations PAUSED
selection: 100 optimizer epochs indexed 1..100; fixed final saved then reloaded; no target selection or early stop

shuffled.permutation: random circular derangement within exact-depth source stratum; singleton uses unused non-source full-CL same-depth node; root fixed; unresolved marked; local numpy Generator only

smoke: Cao seed101 all three arms, full100 epochs, never evaluator; no smoke results pooled; smoke manifests inspected only for schema/integrity/runtime

bootstrap.resample: datasets then paired seeds within selected dataset

statistics.missing: retain failed runs; no imputation; incomplete datasets/seed pairs flagged partial; no confirmatory-complete language from partial matrix
statistics.multiplicity: Holm over 2 contrasts × 3 primary endpoints (6 tests); lineage family separately
statistics.sign_flip: two-sided exact dataset-level sign-flip; n=5 minimal attainable p=2/32=.0625; low power; zero effects retained
statistics.verdict: supportive only for consistently positive per-dataset key effects with CI excluding zero; mixed for opposing directions/endpoints; null if no consistent directional evidence; adverse for consistently negative. All caveats retained.
statistics.weighting: 4 paired seeds averaged within dataset then five datasets equal-weight

hcl.margin: linear 0.3 at epoch20 to 0.05 at epoch50; 0.05 thereafter
